observation: Trade shops pay for GoHighLevel's all-in-one automation platform and use it as a static brochure site with a generic quote form.
opportunity: Done-for-you automation on the stack the shop already pays for: turn on the pipelines, estimate follow-up, and review capture inside their existing GoHighLevel. No new platform to learn, no rip-and-replace. This is the core PING Social consultative pitch.
